Pricing.label: Pricing
Pricing.title: Simple pricing.
Pricing.subtitle: Free for creative talent. Start a free trial for recruiters — upgrade as needed.
Pricing.starterDesc: For individual recruiters trying us out.
Pricing.freeForTalentDesc: Unlimited portfolio, AI summary, analytics, invite inbox — no premium paywall.
Pricing.faq1Q: Does the 14-day trial require a credit card?
Pricing.faq1A: No. Trial can be started with just email & company info. There's no auto-charge when the trial ends.
Pricing.faq2Q: How does payment work in Indonesia?
Pricing.faq2A: We support bank transfer (BCA, Mandiri, BNI, BRI), virtual account, QRIS, and credit card. Invoice with NPWP & PPN available.
Pricing.faq3Q: Is the Team plan per workspace or per seat?
Pricing.faq3A: Per workspace. Rp 2M/mo includes 5 team seats. Add extra seats Rp 250k/seat/mo. No per-candidate fees.
Pricing.faq4Q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
Pricing.faq4A: Yes, anytime. Annual plans get pro-rated refunds. Shortlist & notes data can still be exported after cancellation.
Pricing.faq5Q: Are there discounts for startups or non-profits?
Pricing.faq5A: Yes. Startups (≤20 employees) get 50% off the first 12 months. Non-profits 70% off. Contact sales@talentrank.id.
Pricing.faq6A: SOC 2 Type II compliant. Data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3). Servers in Singapore region. UU PDP Indonesia ready.
Pricing.ctaSubtitle: 14-day trial. No credit card. Cancel anytime.
